facts.text: The hotel is located on Paraga Beach in southern Mykonos.
facts.excerpt: Located on the pristine shores of Paraga Beach in southern Mykonos

facts.text: The hotel sits on the island's rocky southern tip, between Paraga and Paradise Beach.
facts.excerpt: Nestling on the island’s rocky southern tip, the hotel enjoys a prime location between the two most iconic bays in Mykonos: Paraga and Paradise Beach.

facts.text: The architecture is inspired by Cycladic tradition, with clean lines and natural materials.
facts.excerpt: whose architecture, inspired by Cycladic tradition, features clean lines and natural materials that dialogue constantly with the light and the sea.

facts.text: Depending on the category, suites offer a private pool, a jacuzzi or panoramic terraces.
facts.excerpt: these settings offer, depending on the categories, private pool, direct access to the jacuzzi or panoramic terraces

facts.text: Terrace Bungalows are junior suites with a private terrace with sunbeds, steps from the water.
facts.excerpt: With a bungalow spirit at one with the sea, these Junior Suites offer a private terrace with sunbeds, like a small garden just steps from the water.

facts.text: The Paraga Room Private Pool, Sea View has a private terrace and a heated pool suspended over the open sea.
facts.excerpt: a spacious private terrace and a spectacular heated pool, suspended over the open sea

facts.text: The Cyclades Villa sits at the hotel's furthest point and has a pool stretching across its entire length facing the open sea.
facts.excerpt: Perched at the hotel’s furthest point for absolute privacy, this two-bedroom villa unveils majestic proportions. Its pool stretches across its entire length facing the open sea

facts.text: The Rock Villa has a panoramic terrace and sea access woven through the rocks.
facts.excerpt: this villa offers a panoramic terrace, 3 sea-view bedrooms (including a 667 sq. m. Master) and a sea access woven through the rocks

facts.text: The Paradiso Villa has seven bedrooms, a private driveway and its own pool.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking the sea, this grand villa offers 7 bedrooms, a private driveway and a terrace as spectacular as its pool.

facts.text: The hotel has the Rock Spa.
facts.excerpt: From high-performance treatments at the Rock Spa to our infinity pool suspended over the horizon

facts.text: ROKA, the Japanese concept, runs the hotel's restaurant and Beach Club.
facts.excerpt: The celebrated Japanese concept ROKA signs the vibrant heart of the hotel: the restaurant and Beach Club of Fouquet’s Mykonos.

facts.text: Éole serves Greek-Mediterranean cuisine all day, with a Pool Club facing the Aegean Sea.
facts.excerpt: Greek-Mediterranean cuisine, a Pool Club facing the Aegean Sea and the free spirit of the Cyclades. Éole, all day long at Fouquet's Mykonos.

facts.text: Le Bar serves cocktails honoring Fouquet's destinations and a sharing menu, with a terrace.
facts.excerpt: Cocktails honoring Fouquet's destinations, a sharing menu and a terrace tuned to the vibrant energy of Paraga.
